d: The gang goes to a Halloween party, but things take a turn for the worst when Kelly's seductive costume catches the eye of a college student whose intentions are less than honorable.
Emily invites everyone to a secret party at an underground club - where she does something that could end her relationship with Brandon forever.
Emily refuses to accept the fact that Brandon no longer wants to see her and spirals out of control - and Brenda's the only one who might be able to talk her down.
Brandon makes a connection with an aspiring figure skater that could melt ice - but is banned from seeing her by her overprotective coach.
Andrea launches a campaign to create awareness about AIDS and other STDs at West Beverly and finds herself going up against some powerful opponents.
Kelly's loose lips let slip an explosive secret that almost destroys her mother's relationship with Mel.
Dylan's attempts to help a friend through AA put a serious strain on his relationship with Brenda.
Brandon's father becomes involved in a lucrative real estate deal - until Brandon discovers that if the deal goes through, Nat will lose the Peach Pit.
A robbery at the Peach Pit leaves Brenda more traumatized than she's willing to admit - especially when she must identify her attacker in a police lineup.

st: Things to do on a Rainy Day
d: David leads Brenda, Kelly, and Donna to the Bel Age Hotel on a mission to meet the pop group 'Color Me Badd' when they come to town.
When the Taylor house suddenly floods from a ruptured water pipe, the Walshes reluctantly agree to host Mel and Jackie's wedding at theirs.
Summer vacation begins and Brenda starts lying to her parents to see Dylan. Brandon starts his summer job at the Beach Club.

st: The Twins, the Trustee and the Very Big Trip
d: The Walsh's become upset over Brenda's relationship with Dylan, and Steve gets himself into a jam with twins.
Brenda and Donna arrive in Paris while Dylan struggles with his father's plan to gain parole from prison.

st: Sex, Lies and Volleyball / Photo Fini
d: While Donna works as a model in Paris, David wonders whether his heart belongs to Donna.
Brenda pretends to be French to spend time with an American student in Paris.
Brenda and Donna return from Paris, and Brenda suspects that Dylan may have been romantically involved with Kelly during the summer.
